R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

5G device testing value chain › Shuffler 與 CMsequencer
來源描述 [[Shuffler]] 可在 one go 執行 device 支援 UE band combos 的 RF / throughput test，並以 one test script with one test report 取得 RF TX/RX measurement、RX sensitivity、Throughput、VoLTE / VoNR 等 summarized results。來源說：

- Shuffler tests part of [[R&S CMX-KF612M]] test package。
- Shuffler implemented in [[R&S CMsequencer]]。
- Band combinations 可由 UE capabilities 或 user-defined Excel sheet 輸入。
- Band combo support table 包含 LTE 4/5 LTE CA、LTE + NR 4 LTE + 2 NR / 5 LTE + 2 NR、NR 2–4 NR CA、NRDC、LTE + FR1、LTE + FR2。

此處為 solution overview；[[R&S CMX-KF612M]] 的正式 feature list、order number、CSW version 與 supported bands 仍需正式 R&S 文件補證。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

- [[Network operator]]。
- [[Device manufacturer]]。
- [[Test house]]。
- [[Chip vendor]]。

這些角色橫跨 Lab、R&D、Production、Operations 與 Use cases，不同階段需要不同層級的 test and measurement instruments。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

5G device testing value chain
[[5G device testing value chain]] 是 [[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]] 中整理的 5G device ecosystem 測試分工：從 chip vendor、device manufacturer、test house 到 network operator，依 Lab、R&D、Production、Operations 與 Use cases 串接 RF、signaling、application、OTA、pre-conformance、conformance、carrier acceptance 與 service / repair 測試。

5G device testing value chain › Manufacturing 目標
來源指出 manufacturing 測試目標包含：

- High yield of devices with high quality。
- Achieve shortest test time possible；time = money。
- Characterize and optimize parametric RF transceiver sub systems。
- Debug and trace。

來源列出的 manufacturing / production 相關工具包含 [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100]]、[[R&S CMX500]] / [[R&S CMW500]] for signaling 與 [[R&S CMQ]]。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

5G device testing value chain › 工具與平台 mapping
來源列出下列工具 / 平台 mapping：

| 測試層 | 來源列出的工具 |
|---|---|
| RF / parametric / characterization | [[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S FSW]]、Oscilloscopes |
| Signaling / protocol / application | [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMsquares]] |
| OTA / chamber | [[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S CMQ]]、[[R&S ATS CATR]] |
| Production / manufacturing | [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100]]、[[R&S CMX500]] / [[R&S CMW500]] |
| Conformance automation | [[R&S CONTEST]] for RRM、PQA、LBS、PCT、NPT、RF OTA |
| Toolchain / scripts | [[R&S CMsequencer]]、[[XLAPI]]、[[SCPI]]、Python |

5G device testing value chain › Carrier aggregation complexity
來源指出 carrier aggregation combinations 依 [[3GPP]] 約有 ~90K test combinations and test plans。來源列出的 examples 包含：

- NSA ENDC combinations for FR2：97 combinations。
- NSA ENDC combinations FR1 & FR2：26 combinations。

- SA NR CA combinations FR1 5CC & 6CC：150 combinations。
- SA NR CA combinations FR1 + FR2：193 combinations。
- SA NR DC combinations FR1 + FR2：27 combinations。

來源未提供 3GPP document、release、band-combination table ID 或完整 test plan reference，因此不可將上述數字當成正式標準索引。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

5G device testing value chain › Validation and Conformance 目標
來源指出 validation and conformance 測試目標包含：

- Chipset L1–L4 test plan and verification。
- Investigate and debug modem stack。
- Validate and optimize end to end performance of IMS / SIP / TCP/IP。
- Investigate and debug app stack。
- Plan、develop、execute 3GPP / carrier device tests。
- Radiated and conducted testing。

測試目的包含：

- Final product according to [[3GPP]] specs and KPIs 的 conformance。
- Final product for different carriers 的 conformance。
- New product introduction test framework 與 pilot production tests。
- 確認 HW / SW 如設計般運作。
- Cellular transceiver systems optimization。
- Meet 3GPP specifications or custom design criteria。
- Assure robustness / reliability and performance on L1–L3。
- Optimize each stack for highest throughput and defined KPIs。
- Ensure robustness / reliability and performance on IMS、TCP/IP stack and app protocols。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 支撐。
- 來源是 PR / demonstration positioning，不是正式 datasheet、configuration guide、test case list 或 certification document。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi 7 的 option code、software release、支援 RF chains 數量、MLO link combination、measurement uncertainty 或完整 test coverage。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMP180]] 480 MHz waveform 的正式 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 標準地位、量測規格或 production throughput。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Interworking：WLAN offloading 與 Voice over WLAN
同一來源也把 [[R&S CMX500]] 用於 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstration：

- [[WLAN offloading]] 是把原本 intended for cellular networks 的 data 透過 WLAN 傳送，以減少 cellular bands data load。
- [[Voice over WLAN]] 情境聚焦在 cellular network 與 WLAN 之間 handover during a voice call，以維持 uninterrupted voice call experience。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway，可測試 WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement function 可用於 voice over WLAN applications 的 quality of experience early-stage 評估。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術挑戰
來源將 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 描述為 designed for extremely high data throughput，面向 tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。來源列出的 higher throughput key elements：

| 技術項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| channel bandwidth | increased channel bandwidth of 320 MHz |
| spatial streams | up to 16 spatial streams |
| modulation | 4096 QAM modulation |
| MLO | key feature；使 multiple RF chains 測試環境變重要 |

NR-NTN conformance testing › Rohde & Schwarz 測試系統
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz prepares for NR-NTN conformance testing by successfully verifying first test cases in line with 3GPP]]，test cases are conducted on：

- [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]
- [[R&S TS-RRM]]

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz achieves highest number of GCF validated 3GPP NR NTN test cases for RF, RRM and PCT domains]]，all measurements were conducted on：

- [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]
- [[R&S TS-RRM]]
- [[R&S CMX500]]

來源並明示 measurements 在 [[NR FR1]] 執行，DUT 為 latest [[Samsung NR-NTN chipset]] from [[Samsung]]。

來源也說 [[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] conformance test solutions 的核心 5G one-box signaling tester，支援 early R&D through integrated [[Fading]] and [[channel emulation]]，以及 intuitive tool for visualizing satellite constellations；[[R&S CONTEST]] test system software platform facilitates execution of [[3GPP]] test cases。

NR-NTN conformance testing › WI-555 / RFT 555 狀態口徑
較早來源 [[Rohde & Schwarz prepares for NR-NTN conformance testing by successfully verifying first test cases in line with 3GPP]] 說 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 正與 Tier 1 chipset vendors 合作，successfully verifying their respective platforms and the test cases outlined in [[WI-555]] and [[RFT 555]]。同一來源也說 successful validation will activate [[WI-555]] and [[RFT 555]] and kick off conformance testing for [[NR-NTN]] devices。

較新語境的 [[Rohde & Schwarz achieves highest number of GCF validated 3GPP NR NTN test cases for RF, RRM and PCT domains]] 說：

- 已 successful validated highest number in [[GCF]] conformance test cases for [[NR-NTN]] to this date。
- validated test cases within [[GCF]] [[WI-555]] are defined according to [[3GPP]] test specifications for [[RF]]、[[RRM]] and [[PCT]]。
- 該結果 presented at recent [[Global Certification Forum]] meeting [[CAG #86]] in Düsseldorf。
- 來源同時提到 following successful validation of the first 5G-based [[NR-NTN]] at [[PTCRB]]。

⚠️ [[Rohde & Schwarz achieves highest number of GCF validated 3GPP NR NTN test cases for RF, RRM and PCT domains]]（raw created 2026-09-11；發布日期未標示）說 validated test cases within [[GCF]] [[WI-555]] have been achieved and presented at [[CAG #86]]，但既有頁面 [[NR-NTN conformance testing]] 說 successful validation will activate [[WI-555]] and [[RFT 555]]。判斷：新來源代表 GCF validation 狀態已有進展，但因兩份來源皆未標示發布日期與正式 activation date，本頁把較早來源視為 pre-validation readiness，把新來源視為後續 PR claim；仍不得推論完整 test case list、activation date 或 certification body minutes。

NR-NTN conformance testing › 來源中的定義與範圍
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz prepares for NR-NTN conformance testing by successfully verifying first test cases in line with 3GPP]]，[[3GPP conformance testing]] 是確保 devices and networks comply with global standards in mobile telecommunications 的必要活動。

對 [[NR-NTN]] 而言：

- [[GCF]] established [[WI-555]]。
- [[PTCRB]] established [[RFT 555]]。
- 兩者皆依照 [[3GPP]] test specifications。
- WI / RFT 將包含 [[RF]]、[[RRM]] 與 [[PCT]] test cases。
- 測試目標為準備 [[NR-NTN]] in [[NR FR1]] 的 GCF / PTCRB validation。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz achieves highest number of GCF validated 3GPP NR NTN test cases for RF, RRM and PCT domains]]，[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱已成功 validated highest number in [[GCF]] conformance test cases for [[NR-NTN]] to this date，且 validation covers all three domains：[[RF]]、[[RRM]] 與 [[PCT]]，as defined in [[3GPP Release 17]]。

NR-NTN conformance testing › 使用限制
- 本頁不是 [[3GPP]]、[[GCF]] 或 [[PTCRB]] 的正式 conformance test specification。
- 新來源未提供 validated test case 數量、IDs、domain 分布、pass / fail criteria、GCF minutes 或 validation certificate。
- 新來源未提供 [[CAG #86]] 的完整日期與 official meeting reference。
- 新來源未提供 [[Samsung NR-NTN chipset]] 的正式型號、firmware、software release、module / device name 或 DUT setup。
- 新來源未提供 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]、[[R&S TS-RRM]]、[[R&S CMX500]] 的 formal configuration、software versions 或 option stack。
- satellite constellation visualization tool 未明示正式產品名；不得直接等同 [[Constellation Insight Tool]]，只能列為可能相關待查。

- [[CMX500 NTN one-box tester]]：描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 NTN all-in-one / one-box tester 的 PR positioning。本頁補入 GCF validated conformance test case claim。
- [[5G NTN validation and testing]]：整理 NTN validation、partner testing、demo 與 certification test plan。本頁補入 GCF/PTCRB conformance validation 口徑。
- [[CMX500 NR-NTN configuration]]：整理 NR-NTN application-specific configuration rules。本頁不提供 option stack 或 formal product configuration。
- [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]：若來源提供 further information link 或 PR positioning，不能自動推導 OBT BOM；正式配置仍需 specification / configuration guide。

[[NR-NTN conformance testing]] 是依 [[3GPP]] test specifications 驗證 [[NR-NTN]] devices / platforms 是否符合全球行動通訊標準的 conformance testing 活動；它與 [[GCF]] [[WI-555]]、[[PTCRB]] [[RFT 555]]、[[RF]]、[[RRM]]、[[PCT]] 與 [[NR FR1]] 明確相關。

R&S TS-PCT › 來源中的說法
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz has achieved initial verification of 3GPP Rel. 17 power-saving feature SSSG for 5G NR]]：

- [[R&S TS-PCT]] 是 protocol conformance test platform from [[Rohde & Schwarz]]。
- 來源稱 [[R&S TS-PCT]] based on [[R&S CMX500]] 5G one-box signaling tester。

R&S TS-PCT
[[R&S TS-PCT]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 protocol conformance test platform；依 [[Rohde & Schwarz has achieved initial verification of 3GPP Rel. 17 power-saving feature SSSG for 5G NR]]，它 based on [[R&S CMX500]] 5G one-box signaling tester，並被用於 [[Search Space Set Group Switching]]（SSSG）相關 [[3GPP RAN5]] [[TS 38.523-1]] TC 7.1.1.12.5 early verification。

R&S TS-PCT › 可追溯範圍
本頁可支持的主張限於：

- [[R&S TS-PCT]] 在該 PR 中被描述為 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] protocol conformance test platform。
- [[R&S TS-PCT]] 在該 PR 中被描述為 based on [[R&S CMX500]]。
- [[R&S TS-PCT]] 被用於 [[Search Space Set Group Switching]] SSSG 的 [[TS 38.523-1]] TC 7.1.1.12.5 early verification。

不可由本來源推論：

- [[R&S TS-PCT]] 的完整硬體組態、software release、license option、order number、支援標準清單或正式 datasheet 規格。

- 來源未明示 [[R&S TS-PCT]] 是否使用 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、其他 [[R&S CMX500]] configuration，或 additional test system components。

| Capability | Why it matters for semiconductor / device validation context | Raw evidence |

| Multi-technology, multi-channel signaling test | R&S CMX500 is described as a “multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester,” which is central for validating modern wireless devices across evolving standards. | [66] |
| Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn signaling test capability | R&S added Wi‑Fi 8 testing capabilities to CMX500, enabling validation of next-generation WLAN devices before the standard ecosystem fully matures. | [66] |
| Prototype device validation | The R&S/Broadcom setup is stated to validate a prototype Wi‑Fi 8 device, which is directly relevant to early silicon / platform validation workflows. | [66] |
| Physical-layer feature validation | The same setup showcases physical-layer features unique to Wi‑Fi 8, indicating PHY-focused signaling validation capability. | [66] |
| Chamber and OTA ecosystem integration | CMX500 is integrated with ETS-Lindgren chamber technology and EMQuest software, expanding comprehensive wireless testing capability in chamber-based environments. | [65] |
| Combined signaling and RF stimulus ecosystem | The CMX500 one-box signaling tester and R&S SMBV100B vector signal generator are both integrated with ETS-Lindgren chamber technology and EMQuest software, supporting broader wireless test setups. | [65] |

cited_passages.text: The [CMX500](https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/us/products/test-and-measurement/wireless-tester-network-emulator/cmx500-5g-one-box-signaling-tester_63493-601282.html "CMX500") one-box signaling tester and [R&S®SMBV100B](https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/us/products/test-and-measurement/vector-signal-generators/rs-smbv100b-vector-signal-generator_63493-519808.html "R&S®SMBV100B") vector signal generator from Rohde & Schwarz are now integrated with the chamber technology and EMQuest™ software from ETS-Lindgren. With this integration, the two companies continue their partnership to advance comprehensive testing capabilities for wireless technologies.
